verdict.rationale: Deel exposes payroll, contracts, and time data via REST API and an MCP server with tools like listOfContracts, plus webhooks for real-time sync, which supports an agent pulling payroll-related data programmatically. However, there is no explicit documentation of payroll journal entries, GL-code exports, or reconciliation-specific endpoints/tools for ledger accounting. Missing for 10: dedicated payroll journal/GL export endpoint or tool, explicit reconciliation workflow or accounting-system integration guidance, and any evidence of accountants/agents actually using this for ledger reconciliation.
